title: CSS comments bypassed remote URL token detection

reproduction.beforeFix: The gate returned pass for protocol-relative CSS URLs when comments split the url function token or its opening parenthesis.
reproduction.afterFix: The CSS source normalizer removes CSS block comments before matching URL functions, so both forms are rejected.

rootCause: The URL detector normalized CSS escapes but did not account for CSS comment removal before tokenization.
remediation: Remove CSS block comments from the normalized scan text before testing for url() external requests.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "protocol-relative remote CSS"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: url/**/(//host/...) returned pass
